title: Breast Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE Navigator (NCCN Guidelines Version 6.2026)
provenanceNote: Comprehensive NCCN Guidelines Version 6.2026 clinical navigator for Breast Cancer. Covers complete clinical algorithm: Diagnostic Workup and Staging (CAP synoptic, 4-tier HER2, genetics, AYA fertility, distress) -> Upfront Surgery vs Preoperative Systemic Therapy -> Locoregional Surgery (BCS margins, Z0011 omission of ALND, PMRT criteria) -> Post-Neoadjuvant Residual Triage (pCR de-escalation vs Residual escalation with KATHERINE T-DM1, DESTINY-Breast05 T-DXd, CREATE-X capecitabine, OlympiA olaparib, monarchE abemaciclib) -> Adjuvant Systemic Therapy (21-gene Oncotype DX Recurrence Score cutoffs for post/premenopausal) -> Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy (OFS, AI, bone-modifying agents) -> Surveillance and Follow-up -> Recurrent / Metastatic (Biopsy, NGS panel, line-by-line sequences). References StewardMD ONCQIS Standard Protocols. DRAFT - clinical decision support; physician decides and dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
sourceNote: Structured in accordance with NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines) for Breast Cancer Version 6.2026 (July 29, 2026).

a.text: Bone mineral density (DEXA) monitoring is recommended at baseline and every 1-2 years during aromatase inhibitor therapy; add adjuvant bisphosphonate (zoledronic acid 4 mg IV every 6 months for 3-5 years) for postmenopausal patients to prevent osteoporosis and reduce bone recurrence risk (EBCTCG meta-analysis).

b.text: Omission of sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) may be considered in postmenopausal patients >50 years with cT1N0 (axillary ultrasound negative), HR+/HER2-, Grade 1-2 tumors who agree to whole-breast RT and endocrine therapy (SOUND and INSEMA trials; BINV-D).

c.text: Omission of whole-breast radiation therapy may be considered in patients >=65-70 years of age with HR+, HER2-negative, pT1-2 (<=3 cm), pN0 tumors who are committed to receiving 5 years of adjuvant endocrine therapy (CALGB 9343, PRIME II, EUROPA trials; BINV-2).

d.text: Pathologic Complete Response (pCR) is defined as the complete absence of invasive cancer in the breast and axillary lymph nodes (ypT0/is ypN0). In-breast or nodal residual disease (non-pCR) requires escalation of adjuvant therapy to reduce recurrence risk.

e.text: Per ACOSOG Z0011, AMAROS, and SENOMAC trials: for patients with cT1-T2 cN0 disease undergoing breast-conserving surgery and whole-breast radiation who have 1-2 positive sentinel lymph nodes, routine completion axillary lymph node dissection (ALND) is NOT indicated and can be safely omitted with equivalent survival and local control.

nodes.name: Histology
nodes.title: Breast cancer type
nodes.description: Step 1: Clinical Presentation. Select the confirmed histopathologic diagnosis and clinical stage presentation.
bullets: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ (DCIS, Tis N0 M0): Non-invasive malignancy confined within basement membrane (DCIS-1).
Invasive Breast Cancer (cT1-3, cN0-1, M0): Operable or non-metastatic invasive ductal/NST, lobular, or mixed carcinoma (BINV-1).
Inflammatory Breast Cancer (IBC, cT4d): Rapid erythema, edema, and peau d'orange over >=1/3 of breast skin (IBC-1).
Phyllodes Tumor: Rare fibroepithelial neoplasm requiring wide excision with >=1 cm margins (PHYLL-1).
Paget Disease of the Nipple: Eczematous nipple-areolar complex change with underlying DCIS or invasive cancer (PAGET-1).
Breast Cancer During Pregnancy: Gestational cancer requiring trimester-specific systemic and local therapy planning (PREG-1).
Recurrent or Stage IV (Metastatic) Disease: Locoregional recurrence or distant metastatic disease (BINV-18).

options.label: Ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS, Tis N0 M0)
Invasive breast cancer (non-metastatic, cT1-3, cN0-1, M0)
Inflammatory breast cancer (IBC, cT4d, any N, M0)
Paget disease of the nipple (with or without mass)
Recurrent or Stage IV (distant metastatic) disease

nodes.name: DCIS workup
nodes.title: DCIS: workup and staging
nodes.description: DCIS is non-invasive disease confined within basement membrane. Ensure invasion is excluded on core biopsy and establish Estrogen Receptor (ER) status.
bullets: History and physical exam; bilateral diagnostic mammography (magnification views for microcalcifications).
Pathology review: confirm pure DCIS and rule out invasive carcinoma or microinvasion (DCIS-M <=1 mm).
Determine tumor Estrogen Receptor (ER) status by IHC (PR and HER2 testing are NOT recommended for pure DCIS).
Breast MRI is optional and should NOT be routinely used to mandate mastectomy without tissue biopsy.
Genetic counseling referral if patient meets high-risk familial criteria (e.g., age <=50, family history).
Assess distress using NCCN Distress Thermometer and Problem List.

options.label: Workup complete - continue to ER status

nodes.name: DCIS ER Status
nodes.title: DCIS: Estrogen-Receptor (ER) Status
nodes.description: ER status determines whether the patient will benefit from 5 years of adjuvant endocrine risk-reduction therapy following breast-conserving surgery.
bullets: ER-positive (>=1% nuclear staining): 5 years of endocrine therapy cuts subsequent in-breast and contralateral events by 50% (NSABP B-24, IBIS-II).
ER-negative (<1% staining): Endocrine therapy provides no proven clinical benefit and is not indicated.
Surgical margin standard for DCIS: >=2 mm negative margin width reduces ipsilateral breast recurrence rate (SSO/ASTRO/ASCO consensus).
Axillary staging: SLNB is NOT indicated for pure DCIS treated with BCS unless invasive disease is suspected or mastectomy is performed.

nodes.name: DCIS ER+ Treatment
nodes.title: DCIS, ER-Positive: Surgical and Endocrine Risk-Reduction
nodes.description: Curative local-regional therapy with optional 5-year endocrine risk reduction.
bullets: Surgical Options: Breast-conserving surgery (lumpectomy to >=2 mm margins) + Whole-Breast RT (Category 1); OR Total Mastectomy +/- reconstruction (SLNB only if mastectomy or high risk of occult invasion).

Radiation Therapy Options: Whole-breast RT (40-42.5 Gy in 15-16 fx) +/- tumor bed boost; OR Accelerated Partial Breast Irradiation (APBI, Category 2A, RTOG 9804 criteria: screen-detected, grade 1-2, <=2.5 cm, margins >=3 mm).
Radiation Omission: May be considered for low-risk DCIS meeting RTOG 9804 criteria receiving adjuvant endocrine therapy.

Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy (5 years): Tamoxifen 20 mg PO daily (or low-dose 5 mg PO daily for 3 years per TAM-01 if standard dose is poorly tolerated) for pre/postmenopausal patients; or Aromatase Inhibitor (anastrozole 1 mg, letrozole 2.5 mg, exemestane 25 mg) for postmenopausal patients (especially age <60 or thromboembolism risk, NSABP B-35).
Surveillance: Annual bilateral diagnostic mammography beginning 6-12 months post-RT/BCS.

nodes.name: DCIS ER- Treatment
nodes.title: DCIS, ER-Negative: Surgical and Radiation Therapy
nodes.description: Curative local-regional therapy; endocrine therapy is not indicated.
bullets: Surgery: Lumpectomy to negative margins (>=2 mm margin width) + Whole-Breast RT (boost recommended if age <50 or high-grade); OR Total Mastectomy +/- reconstruction.
Axillary staging: SLNB is NOT indicated for pure DCIS treated with BCS unless invasive disease is suspected.
Systemic Therapy: No endocrine therapy, chemotherapy, or HER2-targeted therapy.
Surveillance: Physical exam every 6-12 months for 5 years, then annually; annual bilateral diagnostic mammography.

nodes.name: Invasive Workup
nodes.title: Invasive Breast Cancer: Clinical Workup and Staging
nodes.description: Establish clinical stage (cTNM), Nottingham histologic grade, and receptor status (ER, PR, HER2). This directs primary sequencing between upfront surgery and neoadjuvant therapy.
bullets: History & physical examination; bilateral diagnostic mammogram and breast ultrasound.
Axillary ultrasound: assess nodal status. (SOUND and INSEMA trials: consider omission of surgical axillary staging if >50y, postmenopausal, cT1N0, HR+/HER2-, grade 1-2).
Core needle biopsy: mandatory CAP synoptic pathology with Nottingham histologic grade (G1-G3).
Biomarker testing: ER/PR IHC (record % positive nuclei, note ER-low 1-10%), and HER2 status by validated ASCO/CAP assay (4-tier: IHC 0, 0+ ultralow, 1+ low, 2+ reflex to dual-probe ISH, 3+ positive).
Biopsy marker clip placement: demarcate breast primary tumor bed AND place clip in most suspicious axillary node (essential for Targeted Axillary Dissection [TAD] if neoadjuvant is given).
Genetic counseling & testing: all patients <=50y, TNBC at any age, male breast cancer, personal/family high risk, or candidate for adjuvant olaparib (OlympiA).
Fertility & sexual health counseling (AYA) + serum pregnancy test in all patients of childbearing potential prior to systemic therapy.
Systemic staging imaging (CT chest/abdomen/pelvis + bone scan or FDG-PET/CT): indicated ONLY for Stage III, cN+, or systemic symptoms. Routine imaging for asymptomatic Stage I-II is NOT recommended.

nodes.name: Primary Sequencing
nodes.title: Primary Treatment Sequencing: Upfront Surgery vs Neoadjuvant Therapy
nodes.description: Decide whether to operate upfront or initiate preoperative (neoadjuvant) systemic therapy. Neoadjuvant therapy provides in-vivo chemosensitivity assessment, facilitates breast conservation, and determines post-surgical adjuvant escalation.
bullets: PREOPERATIVE (NEOADJUVANT) THERAPY IS PREFERRED (NCCN BINV-L) FOR:
• HER2-positive breast cancer if >=cT2 (tumor >2 cm) OR >=cN1 (clinically node-positive).
• Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) if >=cT1c (tumor >1 cm) OR >=cN1.
• Locally advanced / inoperable tumors (cT4, bulky cN2, cN3) to render operable.
• Large tumor relative to breast size in a patient desiring breast conservation.
• cN+ disease likely to convert to cN0 (enabling Targeted Axillary Dissection [TAD] and avoiding morbid ALND).
UPFRONT SURGERY IS PREFERRED FOR:
• Clinically node-negative HR+/HER2- early tumors (cT1N0) where upfront genomics (21-gene Oncotype DX) guide adjuvant chemo vs endocrine alone.
• Tumors with extensive in situ component where invasive extent is poorly delineated.

options.label: Upfront surgery (cT1N0 HR+/HER2- or small operable tumor)
Preoperative (neoadjuvant) systemic therapy (preferred for HER2+, TNBC >=T1c/N+, or locally advanced)

nodes.name: Locoregional Surgery
nodes.title: Locoregional Surgery: Breast-Conserving Surgery vs Mastectomy
nodes.description: Breast-conserving surgery (BCS) with radiation therapy produces equivalent overall survival to total mastectomy (Category 1).
bullets: Breast-Conserving Surgery (BCS): Lumpectomy with whole-breast RT +/- boost. Candidate if negative margins achievable with acceptable cosmesis.

Absolute Contraindications to BCS (mandating mastectomy, BINV-G): Inflammatory breast cancer, diffuse microcalcifications, multicentric disease in >2 quadrants, persistently positive margins after re-excision, homozygous ATM mutation, early pregnancy unable to receive RT within 12-16 weeks.
Total Mastectomy: Total, skin-sparing, or nipple-areolar complex (NAC)-sparing mastectomy +/- immediate/delayed reconstruction (tissue expander, implant, autologous DIEP/TRAM/LD flap).

options.label: Breast-conserving surgery (BCS) +/- surgical axillary staging +/- RT
Total mastectomy + surgical axillary staging +/- PMRT

nodes.name: BCS + Radiation Plan
nodes.title: Breast-Conserving Therapy and Radiotherapy Principles
nodes.description: Definitive surgical excision with clear margins, followed by risk-adapted radiation therapy and subsequent systemic therapy.
bullets: Surgical Margins: 'No ink on tumor' is the SSO/ASTRO standard for invasive cancer. (For DCIS, >=2 mm margin required). Re-excision preferred if margin positive.
ACOSOG Z0011 / AMAROS / SENOMAC Criteria: In cT1-T2 cN0 patients undergoing BCS + whole-breast RT with 1-2 positive SLNs, COMPLETION ALND IS SAFELY OMITTED (Category 1).
Radiation Therapy (Category 1): Whole-breast RT (hypofractionated 40-42.5 Gy in 15-16 fractions preferred). Tumor bed boost (10-16 Gy) indicated for age <50, high-grade, or close margins.
Comprehensive Regional Nodal Irradiation (RNI): Mandatory for >=4 positive axillary nodes (Category 1); strongly consider for 1-3 positive nodes.
Radiation Omission: May be considered in patients >=65-70 years with HR+, HER2-, pN0, pT1 (<=2 cm) receiving 5 years of endocrine therapy (CALGB 9343, PRIME II, EUROPA).

options.label: Proceed to Adjuvant Systemic Therapy Subtype Selection

nodes.name: Mastectomy + PMRT Plan
nodes.title: Total Mastectomy and Post-Mastectomy Radiation (PMRT)
nodes.description: Total mastectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy and risk-adapted post-mastectomy radiation therapy (PMRT).
bullets: Surgical Margins: Clear margins required. Re-excision preferred for positive margins; if impossible, deliver PMRT + comprehensive RNI.
Post-Mastectomy Radiation Therapy (PMRT) Indications (BINV-3):
• >=4 positive axillary nodes (pN2-3): PMRT to chest wall + comprehensive RNI is MANDATORY (Category 1).
• 1-3 positive axillary nodes (pN1): STRONGLY CONSIDER PMRT to chest wall + comprehensive RNI (EBCTCG meta-analysis shows recurrence and mortality reduction).
• Node-negative and pT3 (>5 cm): CONSIDER PMRT to chest wall +/- comprehensive RNI.
• Node-negative, <=pT2 (<=5 cm) with clear margins: PMRT is NOT indicated.

Breast Reconstruction: Immediate or delayed tissue expander/implant, autologous DIEP/TRAM/LD flap. If PMRT planned, delayed-immediate or autologous reconstruction preferred to reduce capsular contracture.

options.label: Proceed to Adjuvant Systemic Therapy Subtype Selection

nodes.name: Preoperative Regimens
nodes.title: Preoperative (Neoadjuvant) Regimen Selection
nodes.description: Administer subtype-specific neoadjuvant therapy. Mark primary tumor and biopsied lymph node with image-detectable clips prior to cycle 1.
bullets: HER2-Positive (>=cT2 or cN+): TCHP (Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 + Carboplatin AUC 6 + Trastuzumab 8->6 mg/kg + Pertuzumab 840->420 mg IV q21d x 6 cycles; TRYPHAENA trial pCR 66%) (Category 1).

Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC >=cT1c/cN+): KEYNOTE-522 (Pembrolizumab 200 mg q21d + Carboplatin AUC 5 + Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 weekly x 4 cycles -> Pembrolizumab + Doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 + Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 q21d x 4 cycles; pCR 65%, 37% reduction in event/death) (Category 1).

HR+/HER2- Locally Advanced / High Burden: Dose-Dense AC-T (Doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 + Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 q14d x 4 -> Paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 q14d x 4 with G-CSF) OR Neoadjuvant Endocrine Therapy (Aromatase Inhibitor for 4-6 months, ACOSOG Z1031).
Post-Neoadjuvant Locoregional Surgery: BCS or Total Mastectomy + Targeted Axillary Dissection (TAD: dual tracer, removal of clipped node, >=3 SLNs) if cN1 converted to ycN0.

nodes.name: Pathologic Response
nodes.title: Post-Neoadjuvant Pathology: Pathologic Response Assessment
nodes.description: Pathologic Complete Response (pCR) vs Residual Disease directs whether to de-escalate or escalate adjuvant systemic therapy.
bullets: Pathologic Complete Response (pCR, ypT0/is ypN0): Complete eradication of invasive disease in breast and axillary lymph nodes.
Residual Invasive Disease (Non-pCR, ypT1-4 or ypN>=1): Persistent invasive disease indicates high risk of relapse (20-30% recurrence risk) and demands targeted adjuvant escalation.

options.label: Residual invasive disease (Non-pCR, ypT+ or ypN+)

nodes.name: pCR Subtype
nodes.title: Pathologic Complete Response: Subtype De-escalation
nodes.description: Select tumor receptor subtype to finalize completion regimen following documented pCR.
bullets: HER2-Positive: Complete up to 1 year total of anti-HER2 blockade with Trastuzumab +/- Pertuzumab (APHINITY trial, Category 1).
Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: Complete adjuvant single-agent Pembrolizumab 200 mg q21d x 9 cycles (total 1 year KEYNOTE-522, Category 1).
HR+/HER2-: Adjuvant endocrine therapy (Tamoxifen or Aromatase Inhibitor +/- OFS for 5-10 years) (Category 1).

nodes.name: HER2+ pCR Plan
nodes.title: HER2-Positive with pCR: Complete 1-Year Anti-HER2 Blockade
nodes.description: De-escalated maintenance anti-HER2 therapy following documented pCR.
bullets: Complete up to 1 year of HER2-targeted therapy with Trastuzumab (Category 1) +/- Pertuzumab.
If initially node-positive: Pertuzumab + Trastuzumab is Category 1 preferred (APHINITY 8.4-year follow-up confirms iDFS benefit).
If HR-positive: Add concurrent adjuvant endocrine therapy (Tamoxifen or AI +/- OFS) (Category 1).
Adjuvant Radiation Therapy: Whole-breast RT if BCS; chest wall PMRT + RNI if initially node-positive or cT3-4.

nodes.name: TNBC pCR Plan
nodes.title: Triple-Negative with pCR: Complete Adjuvant Pembrolizumab
nodes.description: Completion of KEYNOTE-522 adjuvant immunotherapy following confirmed pCR.
bullets: Adjuvant Pembrolizumab: 200 mg IV q21d (or 400 mg IV q42d) for up to 9 cycles after surgery (Category 1, KEYNOTE-522).
5-year EFS rate is 92.2% in patients who achieve pCR and complete adjuvant pembrolizumab.
Monitor for immune-mediated adverse events (thyroiditis, hypophysitis, pneumonitis, colitis, hepatitis).
No additional cytotoxic chemotherapy (capecitabine) is needed for patients with confirmed pCR.

nodes.name: HR+ pCR Plan
nodes.title: HR+/HER2- with pCR: Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy
nodes.description: 5 to 10 years of adjuvant endocrine therapy following confirmed pCR.
bullets: Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy for 5-10 years (Category 1).
Premenopausal: Tamoxifen 20 mg daily +/- OFS (Goserelin / Leuprolide); or Aromatase Inhibitor + OFS for 5 years (SOFT/TEXT).
Postmenopausal: Aromatase Inhibitor (Letrozole 2.5 mg, Anastrozole 1 mg, Exemestane 25 mg) for 5 years.
Bone-modifying agents: Zoledronic acid 4 mg IV q6mo x 3-5y in postmenopausal patients.

nodes.name: Residual Subtype
nodes.title: Residual Invasive Disease: Targeted Adjuvant Escalation
nodes.description: Select receptor subtype to deploy evidence-based post-neoadjuvant escalation.
bullets: HER2-Positive Residual: Switch from Trastuzumab to T-DM1 (KATHERINE trial: 50% reduction in recurrence/death; 3-year iDFS 88.3% vs 77.0%) OR Fam-Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd, DESTINY-Breast05, Category 1 for high-risk).
TNBC Residual: Adjuvant Capecitabine (CREATE-X trial: 42% reduction in risk of death) AND/OR Pembrolizumab (KEYNOTE-522) AND/OR Olaparib if germline BRCA1/2 PV (OlympiA trial).
HR+/HER2- Residual: Adjuvant Endocrine + Abemaciclib (monarchE trial: 2 years, Category 1 preferred) or Ribociclib (NATALEE trial: 3 years) + Olaparib if germline BRCA1/2 PV (OlympiA trial).

options.label: HER2-positive with residual: switch to T-DM1 or T-DXd
Triple-negative with residual: capecitabine +/- pembro +/- olaparib
HR+/HER2- with residual: endocrine + CDK4/6i +/- olaparib

nodes.name: HER2+ Residual Plan
nodes.title: HER2-Positive with Residual Disease: Switch to T-DM1 or T-DXd
nodes.description: Category 1 post-neoadjuvant antibody-drug conjugate escalation for residual invasive disease.
bullets: Ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1): 3.6 mg/kg IV q21d x 14 cycles (Category 1, KATHERINE trial). Halves risk of invasive recurrence or death compared to continuing trastuzumab (HR 0.50, P < .001).
Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd): 5.4 mg/kg IV q21d x 14 cycles (Category 1 for patients with high risk of recurrence per DESTINY-Breast05: inoperable at baseline or ypN+).
If T-DM1 discontinued for toxicity: Complete remainder of 1 year with Trastuzumab +/- Pertuzumab (Category 1).
If HR-positive: Add concurrent adjuvant endocrine therapy (Category 1).
Consider extended adjuvant neratinib (ExteNET) after completing anti-HER2 therapy in perceived high-risk HR+ disease.

nodes.name: TNBC Residual Plan
nodes.title: TNBC with Residual Disease: Capecitabine + Pembrolizumab ± Olaparib
nodes.description: Category 1 escalation protocol for residual triple-negative breast cancer.
bullets: Adjuvant Capecitabine: 1000-1250 mg/m2 PO twice daily on Days 1-14 q21d for 6-8 cycles (Category 1, CREATE-X trial: improved 5-year DFS 74.1% vs 67.6%, OS HR 0.52 in TNBC).
Adjuvant Pembrolizumab: Continue single-agent pembrolizumab 200 mg q21d for up to 9 cycles after surgery (Category 1, KEYNOTE-522). Can be given sequentially or concurrently with capecitabine.
Adjuvant Olaparib (if germline BRCA1/2 PV): 300 mg PO BID for 1 year (Category 1, OlympiA trial: 4-year OS 89.8% vs 86.4%, DFS HR 0.58). Administer after completing adjuvant RT.
Adjuvant Radiation Therapy: Whole-breast RT if BCS; chest wall PMRT + comprehensive RNI if ypN+ or initial cT3-4.

nodes.name: HR+ Residual Plan
nodes.title: HR+/HER2- with Residual Disease: Endocrine + CDK4/6i ± Olaparib
nodes.description: Escalated adjuvant protocol for residual HR+/HER2- disease.
bullets: Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy (5-10 years): Aromatase Inhibitor (postmenopausal) or AI/Tamoxifen + OFS (premenopausal).
Adjuvant Abemaciclib (CDK4/6 Inhibitor): 150 mg PO BID x 2 years combined with endocrine therapy (Category 1 preferred, monarchE trial: indicated for residual node-positive or CPS+EG score >=3).
Adjuvant Ribociclib (NATALEE trial): 400 mg daily on Days 1-21 q28d x 3 years with AI (Category 1 preferred for Stage II/III high risk).
Adjuvant Olaparib (if germline BRCA1/2 PV): 300 mg PO BID x 1 year (Category 1, OlympiA trial: indicated for residual disease with CPS+EG score >=3).
Adjuvant Bone-Modifying Agent: Zoledronic acid 4 mg IV q6mo x 3-5 years for postmenopausal patients.

nodes.name: Subtype
nodes.title: Adjuvant Systemic Therapy: Receptor Subtype
nodes.description: Biomarker status (ER, PR, HER2) determines systemic chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and endocrine pathways.
bullets: HR+/HER2- (Ductal/NST, Lobular, Mixed): Genomic testing (21-gene Oncotype DX) determines chemotherapy benefit.
HR+/HER2+ (Triple-Positive): Chemo + dual HER2 blockade (trastuzumab + pertuzumab) + endocrine therapy.
HR-/HER2+ (HER2-Enriched): Chemo + HER2 blockade (TCHP or paclitaxel + trastuzumab for T1N0).
HR-/HER2- (Triple-Negative / TNBC): Dose-dense cytotoxic chemotherapy + adjuvant olaparib if germline BRCA1/2 PV.
Favorable Histologies (Pure tubular, mucinous, cribriform, adenoid cystic): Low-intensity adjuvant therapy.

nodes.name: HR+ Menopause
nodes.title: Adjuvant HR+/HER2-: Menopausal Status
nodes.description: 21-gene Oncotype DX Recurrence Score (RS) cutoffs and chemotherapy indications differ critically by menopausal status (TAILORx, RxPONDER).
bullets: Postmenopausal (BINV-6): 21-gene RS <26 gains NO benefit from chemotherapy, even with 1-3 positive nodes (RxPONDER trial). RS >=26 derives significant chemotherapy benefit.
Premenopausal (BINV-7, BINV-8): Chemotherapy benefit is observed in all node-positive premenopausal patients (RxPONDER) and in node-negative patients with RS 16-25 (TAILORx subset).
Definition of Menopause (BINV-O): Bilateral oophorectomy, age >=60, or age <60 with >=12 months amenorrhea and postmenopausal FSH/estradiol. (Amenorrhea post-chemo requires serial hormonal checks).

nodes.name: HR+ Postmenopausal Plan
nodes.title: Adjuvant HR+/HER2- (Postmenopausal): Genomic-Guided Chemotherapy
nodes.description: Evidence-based systemic adjuvant protocol for postmenopausal HR+/HER2- disease.
bullets: pT1a pN0 (<=0.5 cm): Adjuvant endocrine therapy alone (Category 2B). Chemotherapy is not recommended.
pT1b-T3, pN0 or pN1 (1-3 positive nodes) -> 21-Gene Oncotype DX RS (Category 1):
• Recurrence Score < 26: Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy alone (Category 1). TAILORx and RxPONDER prove NO chemotherapy benefit.
• Recurrence Score >= 26: Adjuvant Chemotherapy (Dose-Dense AC-T or TC) followed by Endocrine Therapy (Category 1).
pN2-3 (>=4 positive nodes): Adjuvant Chemotherapy followed by Endocrine Therapy (Category 1).

CDK4/6 Inhibitor Escalation: 2 years of Abemaciclib (monarchE, Category 1 preferred) or 3 years of Ribociclib (NATALEE, Category 1) for eligible high-risk patients (>=4 nodes, or 1-3 nodes with grade 3 or >=5 cm).
Adjuvant Olaparib: 1 year for germline BRCA1/2 PV with >=4 positive nodes (OlympiA, Category 1).

nodes.name: HR+ Premenopausal Nodal Status
nodes.title: Adjuvant HR+/HER2- (Premenopausal): Pathologic Nodal Status
nodes.description: Determines whether chemotherapy is guided by Oncotype DX (pN0) or indicated upfront (pN+).
bullets: Node-Negative (pN0, BINV-7): 21-gene RS <=15 (endocrine alone); RS 16-25 (chemo -> endocrine +/- OFS vs endocrine + OFS); RS >=26 (chemo -> endocrine + OFS).
Node-Positive (pN1-3, BINV-8): Prospective RxPONDER trial showed chemotherapy improves invasive DFS by 5% in all premenopausal women with 1-3 positive nodes regardless of RS score.

nodes.name: Premenopausal pN0 Plan
nodes.title: Adjuvant HR+/HER2- (Premenopausal, pN0): 21-Gene RS Stratification
nodes.description: Genomic-guided protocol for premenopausal node-negative disease.
bullets: Recurrence Score <= 15: Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy alone +/- Ovarian Function Suppression (OFS). No chemotherapy benefit in TAILORx.
Recurrence Score 16-25: Adjuvant Chemotherapy followed by Endocrine Therapy +/- OFS (Category 1); or alternatively Endocrine Therapy + OFS (Goserelin / Leuprolide) + Aromatase Inhibitor.
Recurrence Score >= 26: Adjuvant Chemotherapy (Dose-Dense AC-T or TC) followed by Endocrine Therapy + OFS (Category 1).
CDK4/6 Inhibitor: Consider 3 years of Ribociclib + AI + OFS for eligible Stage II patients (NATALEE trial, Category 1).

nodes.name: Premenopausal pN+ Plan
nodes.title: Adjuvant HR+/HER2- (Premenopausal, pN+): Chemotherapy Recommended
nodes.description: Chemotherapy and intensive endocrine suppression for premenopausal node-positive disease.
bullets: Chemotherapy (Category 1): Adjuvant Chemotherapy (Dose-Dense AC-T or TC) followed by Endocrine Therapy + OFS (RxPONDER trial: 5% absolute iDFS benefit in premenopausal node-positive women).
Ovarian Function Suppression (OFS): Mandatory 5 years of Goserelin 3.6 mg SC q4w or Leuprolide + Aromatase Inhibitor (SOFT/TEXT trials: AI + OFS superior to tamoxifen).
CDK4/6 Inhibitor: 2 years of Abemaciclib (monarchE trial, Category 1 preferred) or 3 years of Ribociclib (NATALEE trial, Category 1) for high-risk criteria.
Adjuvant Olaparib: 1 year for germline BRCA1/2 PV with >=4 positive nodes (OlympiA trial, Category 1).

nodes.name: Triple-Positive Plan
nodes.title: Adjuvant Triple-Positive (HR+/HER2+): Chemo + Dual HER2 Blockade + Endocrine
nodes.description: Comprehensive adjuvant protocol combining dual HER2 blockade and endocrine therapy.
bullets: Preferred Regimen: TCHP (Docetaxel + Carboplatin + Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab) x 6 cycles; OR Dose-dense AC followed by Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab (AC-THP).
Node-Positive Disease: Chemotherapy + Pertuzumab + Trastuzumab is Category 1 preferred (APHINITY trial 8.4-year update confirms iDFS benefit in node-positive).
Small Node-Negative (pT1b-cN0 <=1 cm): Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab weekly x 12 weeks followed by Trastuzumab to complete 1 year (APT trial 10-year iDFS 91.3%).
Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy: Initiate upon completion of chemotherapy; continue for 5-10 years (Tamoxifen or AI +/- OFS).
Extended Neratinib: Consider 1 year of oral neratinib following trastuzumab in high-risk HR+/HER2+ disease (ExteNET trial: HR 0.60).

nodes.name: HER2-Enriched Plan
nodes.title: Adjuvant HER2-Enriched (HR-/HER2+): Chemo + Dual HER2 Blockade
nodes.description: Intensive HER2-targeted chemotherapy; endocrine therapy is not indicated.
bullets: Node-Positive or Tumor >1 cm: TCHP (Docetaxel + Carboplatin + Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab) x 6 cycles followed by Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab to complete 1 year (Category 1, preferred).
Small Node-Negative (pT1b-cN0 0.6-1.0 cm): Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 weekly x 12 weeks + Trastuzumab followed by Trastuzumab to complete 1 year (APT trial, Category 1).
pT1a pN0 (<=0.5 cm): Consider adjuvant chemotherapy + Trastuzumab (Category 2B).
Endocrine Therapy: Not indicated for ER-negative/PR-negative disease.
Cardiac Monitoring: Baseline and q3-month echocardiogram/MUGA for LVEF during trastuzumab therapy.

nodes.name: Adjuvant TNBC Plan
nodes.title: Adjuvant Triple-Negative: Chemo-Immunotherapy and PARP Inhibition
nodes.description: Category 1 adjuvant cytotoxic protocol for triple-negative breast cancer.
bullets: Preferred Chemotherapy: Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel every 2 weeks x 4 cycles (or weekly Paclitaxel x 12 weeks) with G-CSF support (Category 1, EBCTCG meta-analysis).
Non-Anthracycline Option: TC (Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 + Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 q21d x 4-6 cycles) if cardiac contraindication.
Adjuvant Olaparib (OlympiA trial): 300 mg PO BID x 1 year for patients with germline BRCA1/2 pathogenic variant and tumor >=pT2 or >=pN1 (Category 1, 4-year OS 89.8% vs 86.4%). Initiate post-RT.
Small pT1a pN0 (<=0.5 cm): No adjuvant systemic chemotherapy is indicated.
No endocrine therapy or HER2-targeted therapy is indicated.

nodes.name: Favorable Histology Plan
nodes.title: Adjuvant: Favorable Histologies (Tubular, Mucinous, Cribriform)
nodes.description: De-escalated adjuvant therapy for pure favorable histologies.
bullets: Histologies: Pure tubular, pure mucinous (>90%), pure cribriform, adenoid cystic carcinoma.
Must be Nottingham Grade 1-2, pure histology, and HER2-negative.
Tumor < 1 cm, pN0: Adjuvant endocrine therapy for risk reduction.
Tumor 1 - 2.9 cm, pN0: Adjuvant endocrine therapy alone (tamoxifen or AI) for 5 years.
Tumor >= 3 cm or pN+: Adjuvant endocrine therapy +/- chemotherapy.

nodes.name: Adjuvant Endocrine
nodes.title: Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy: Menopausal Status and Risk Stratification
nodes.description: Endocrine therapy reduces recurrence and mortality by 40-50% in HR+ disease. Select menopausal status.
bullets: Postmenopausal (BINV-K 4 of 4): Aromatase Inhibitor (Letrozole, Anastrozole, Exemestane) for 5 years (Category 1). Extended AI for 7.5-10 years for node-positive patients.

Premenopausal (BINV-K 3 of 4): Tamoxifen for 5-10 years; OR Aromatase Inhibitor + Ovarian Function Suppression (OFS: Goserelin / Leuprolide) for 5 years (SOFT/TEXT trials: AI+OFS significantly superior in high-risk premenopausal women).
CDK4/6 Inhibitor Combination: 2 years of Abemaciclib (monarchE) or 3 years of Ribociclib (NATALEE) for eligible high-risk patients.
Adjuvant Bone-Modifying Agent: Zoledronic acid 4 mg IV q6mo x 3-5 years reduces bone recurrence (EBCTCG meta-analysis, Category 1).

nodes.name: Postmenopausal Endocrine
nodes.title: Adjuvant Endocrine (Postmenopausal) ± CDK4/6 Inhibitor
nodes.description: Category 1 adjuvant endocrine protocol for postmenopausal patients.
bullets: Initial Therapy (5 years): Aromatase Inhibitor (Letrozole 2.5 mg daily, Anastrozole 1 mg daily, or Exemestane 25 mg daily) (Category 1 preferred).
Extended Therapy (7.5 - 10 years total): Additional 3-5 years of AI for node-positive or high-risk patients (MA-17 trial, ATLAS trial).
Adjuvant CDK4/6 Inhibitor: Abemaciclib 150 mg PO BID x 2 years (monarchE, Category 1 preferred) OR Ribociclib 400 mg daily d1-21 q28d x 3 years (NATALEE, Category 1) for high-risk criteria.
Adjuvant Bone Protection: Baseline DEXA scan; Zoledronic acid 4 mg IV every 6 months for 3-5 years to prevent osteoporosis and reduce bone recurrence (EBCTCG meta-analysis, Category 1).
Tamoxifen Alternative: Tamoxifen 20 mg daily for 5-10 years only if AI is contraindicated or not tolerated.

nodes.name: Premenopausal Endocrine
nodes.title: Adjuvant Endocrine (Premenopausal): Tamoxifen vs OFS + AI ± CDK4/6i
nodes.description: Category 1 adjuvant endocrine protocol for premenopausal patients.
bullets: High Risk (Node-positive, Grade 3, or Young Age <35): Ovarian Function Suppression (OFS: Goserelin 3.6 mg SC q4w or Leuprolide 3.75 mg IM q4w) + Aromatase Inhibitor (Exemestane or Letrozole) for 5 years (Category 1, SOFT and TEXT trials: 15-year DFS 73.5% vs 67.0% for tamoxifen alone).
Standard Risk: Tamoxifen 20 mg PO daily for 5 years (Category 1) +/- OFS; consider extending to 10 years total (ATLAS trial).
Adjuvant CDK4/6 Inhibitor: Abemaciclib 150 mg PO BID x 2 years (monarchE) or Ribociclib 400 mg daily d1-21 q28d x 3 years (NATALEE) with AI + OFS for eligible high-risk patients.
Safety Pearl: Do NOT administer an Aromatase Inhibitor to a premenopausal woman WITHOUT confirmed, continuous Ovarian Function Suppression!

nodes.name: Surveillance
nodes.title: Post-Therapy Surveillance and Survivorship
nodes.description: Long-term monitoring schedule and survivorship management following curative breast cancer therapy.
bullets: Clinical History & Physical Exam: Every 3 to 6 months for the first 5 years, then annually thereafter.
Annual Mammography: Begin 6 to 12 months after completion of radiation therapy (or BCS if no RT given), and annually thereafter.
Routine Imaging of Reconstructed Breast: NOT indicated after total mastectomy.
Bone Health Monitoring: DEXA scan at baseline and every 1-2 years for patients on aromatase inhibitors or ovarian suppression.

WHAT NOT TO DO IN ASYMPTOMATIC PATIENTS (NCCN BINV-17, Category 1): Routine CBC, LFTs, tumor markers (CEA, CA 15-3, CA 27.29), CT scans, bone scans, and PET/CT scans are NOT recommended in the absence of signs/symptoms of recurrence (no survival advantage and potential harm from false-positives).
Lymphedema Management: Educate on symptoms, early referral for compression garments and decongestive physical therapy.
Cardiovascular Monitoring: Follow LVEF every 3 months during active anti-HER2 therapy; long-term monitoring if anthracycline-treated.

nodes.name: Recurrence Extent
nodes.title: Recurrent / Stage IV: Location and Extent of Disease
nodes.description: Biopsy documentation of first recurrence is mandatory to re-evaluate ER, PR, and HER2 (discordance occurs in 15-30%).
bullets: Biopsy of First Recurrence: Mandatory tissue biopsy of metastatic/recurrent lesion to re-evaluate ER/PR and HER2 (discordance in 15-30% changes management).
4-Tier HER2 Testing (ASCO/CAP 2023): HER2 3+ (positive), HER2 2+ (equivocal reflex to ISH), HER2 1+ (low), HER2 0+ (ultralow), HER2 0 (null).
Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) Multigene Panel (tissue or ctDNA): PIK3CA, AKT1, PTEN, ESR1, germline BRCA1/2, PALB2, MSI-H/dMMR, TMB-H, RET, NTRK.
Systemic Staging: Diagnostic CT chest/abdomen/pelvis with contrast + bone scan (or FDG-PET/CT); brain MRI if neurologic symptoms present.
Bone Metastases Management (BINV-21): Add Zoledronic acid 4 mg IV q12w or Denosumab 120 mg SQ q4w + Calcium/Vit D + preventive dental exam.

options.label: Local recurrence only (in-breast or chest wall without overt metastases)
Regional nodal recurrence (axillary, supraclavicular, internal mammary)
Distant metastatic disease (Stage IV M1: bone, visceral, brain)

nodes.name: Local Recurrence Plan
nodes.title: Management of Isolated Local Recurrence
nodes.description: Curative multidisciplinary salvage protocol for isolated local breast/chest wall recurrence.
bullets: Prior BCS without prior RT: Surgical resection (repeat BCS or mastectomy) + Whole-breast/chest-wall RT (Category 1).
Prior BCS with prior RT: Total mastectomy + surgical axillary staging (repeat SLNB or ALND) +/- repeat RT if feasible.
Prior Mastectomy without prior RT: Surgical excision of chest wall recurrence + PMRT to chest wall and supraclavicular nodes.
Systemic Adjuvant Chemotherapy (CALOR trial): Adjuvant chemotherapy improves 5-year DFS (69% vs 57%, HR 0.59) and OS (88% vs 76%), with greatest benefit in ER-negative local recurrences.
Systemic Endocrine Therapy: 5 years of endocrine therapy for ER-positive recurrences.

nodes.name: Regional Recurrence Plan
nodes.title: Management of Isolated Regional (Nodal) Recurrence
nodes.description: Locoregional salvage and systemic therapy for regional lymph node recurrence.
bullets: Axillary Recurrence (prior SLNB only): Surgical resection of gross disease + Complete ALND (level I/II) + Radiation Therapy.
Axillary Recurrence (prior ALND): Surgical resection of gross disease if feasible + Radiation Therapy (repeat RT if feasible).
Supraclavicular / Infraclavicular / Internal Mammary Recurrence: Comprehensive Radiation Therapy (or repeat RT) + systemic therapy.
Systemic Therapy: Administer full course of systemic chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and endocrine therapy based on biomarker restaging.

nodes.name: Metastatic Subtype
nodes.title: Metastatic Breast Cancer: Biomarker Subtype Stratification
nodes.description: Therapy is governed by ER, PR, HER2 status, and actionable genomic alterations.
bullets: HR+/HER2- (BINV-22): Endocrine therapy + CDK4/6 inhibitor is the preferred first-line standard (chemotherapy reserved ONLY for true visceral crisis).
HER2-Positive (BINV-24, BINV-26): Dual anti-HER2 blockade (CLEOPATRA THP) followed by T-DXd (DESTINY-Breast03) and tucatinib triplet (HER2CLIMB).
Triple-Negative / TNBC (BINV-27): PD-L1 CPS guided chemo-immunotherapy (KEYNOTE-355), Sacituzumab govitecan (ASCENT), and PARP inhibitors.

options.label: HER2-positive (HR+ or HR- with HER2 IHC 3+ or ISH+)

nodes.name: Line of Therapy
nodes.title: Metastatic HR+/HER2-: Line of Therapy and Endocrine Sensitivity
nodes.description: Select whether patient is treatment-naive, progressing on 1L CDK4/6 inhibitor, or endocrine-refractory.
bullets: First-Line (1L): Aromatase inhibitor + CDK4/6 inhibitor (Ribociclib Category 1 with proven OS benefit in MONALEESA-2/7).
Post-CDK4/6 Inhibitor Progression (2L): Biomarker-directed targeted therapy based on NGS (PIK3CA, AKT1, PTEN, ESR1, BRCA1/2).
Endocrine-Refractory / Visceral Crisis: Switch to antibody-drug conjugates (T-DXd for HER2-low, Sacituzumab govitecan) or cytotoxic chemotherapy.

options.label: First-line (1L): no prior endocrine therapy for metastatic disease
Second-line (2L): progression on prior endocrine + CDK4/6 inhibitor
Endocrine-refractory or visceral crisis: candidate for chemotherapy / ADCs

nodes.name: 1L HR+/HER2- Regimen
nodes.title: Metastatic HR+/HER2- 1L: Endocrine Therapy + CDK4/6 Inhibitor
nodes.description: Preferred Category 1 first-line standard of care for advanced HR+/HER2- disease.
bullets: Preferred 1L Regimen: Nonsteroidal Aromatase Inhibitor (Letrozole 2.5 mg or Anastrozole 1 mg daily) + CDK4/6 Inhibitor.

Ribociclib: 600 mg PO daily Days 1-21 q28d (Category 1, MONALEESA-2 & MONALEESA-7 trials: proven statistically significant Overall Survival benefit, median OS 63.9 vs 51.4 months). Monitor ECG (QTcF) and LFTs.
Abemaciclib: 150 mg PO BID continuous (Category 2A, MONARCH 3 trial: median PFS 28.2 vs 14.8 months).
Palbociclib: 125 mg PO daily Days 1-21 q28d (Category 2A, PALOMA-2 trial).
If Premenopausal: Add Ovarian Function Suppression (Goserelin / Leuprolide) or bilateral oophorectomy (Category 1).
True Visceral Crisis (severe organ compromise, BINV-Q 2): Chemotherapy or ADC indicated for immediate disease control.

nodes.name: Metastatic Genomics
nodes.title: Metastatic HR+/HER2- 2L: Actionable Genomic Alterations
nodes.description: Select the detected driver alteration from plasma ctDNA or tumor tissue NGS.
bullets: PIK3CA / AKT1 / PTEN Alterations: Capivasertib + Fulvestrant (CAPItello-291, Category 1) OR Fulvestrant/Inavolisib/Palbociclib (INAVO120, Category 1).
ESR1 Mutation (frequent post-AI resistance): Elacestrant oral SERD (EMERALD, Category 2A) or Imlunestrant (EMBER-3) or Vepdegestrant.
Germline BRCA1/2 Pathogenic Variant: PARP Inhibitor monotherapy (Olaparib or Talazoparib, Category 1).
HER2-Low (IHC 1+ or IHC 2+/ISH-) or HER2-Ultralow (IHC 0+): Fam-Trastuzumab deruxtecan (DESTINY-Breast04 / DESTINY-Breast06).
Biomarker Wild-Type / No Actionable Target: Everolimus + Exemestane (BOLERO-2) or Fulvestrant + CDK4/6i switch.

options.label: ESR1 mutation (detected in plasma ctDNA or tissue)
Germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variant

nodes.name: Capivasertib Plan
nodes.title: PIK3CA / AKT1 / PTEN Altered: Capivasertib + Fulvestrant
nodes.description: Category 1 targeted therapy for PI3K/AKT/PTEN pathway-altered metastatic disease.
bullets: Capivasertib + Fulvestrant: Capivasertib 400 mg PO BID Days 1-4 weekly (4 days on, 3 days off) + Fulvestrant 500 mg IM Days 1, 15, then q28d (Category 1, CAPItello-291 trial: median PFS 7.3 vs 3.1 months in altered cohort, HR 0.50). Monitor for diarrhea and hyperglycemia.

Fulvestrant / Inavolisib / Palbociclib Triplet: Inavolisib 9 mg daily + Palbociclib 125 mg d1-21 + Fulvestrant (Category 1 preferred for PIK3CA mutation progressing on/within 12 mo of adjuvant ET, INAVO120 trial: median PFS 15.0 vs 7.3 months, HR 0.43; OS benefit 34 vs 27 months, HR 0.67).
Alpelisib + Fulvestrant: 300 mg PO daily + Fulvestrant (SOLAR-1 trial, Category 1). Requires baseline HbA1c <6.5% and prophylactic antihistamines for rash.

nodes.name: Elacestrant Plan
nodes.title: ESR1-Mutated: Elacestrant (Oral Selective ER Degrader)
nodes.description: Oral SERD for acquired ESR1-mutated endocrine resistance.
bullets: Elacestrant: 345 mg PO once daily continuous with food (Category 2A, EMERALD trial: median PFS 8.6 vs 1.9 months in patients with prior CDK4/6i >=12 months, HR 0.41).
Indicated for ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer with ESR1 mutation following progression on at least one line of endocrine therapy.
Imlunestrant: 400 mg PO daily (Category 2A, EMBER-3 trial: median PFS 5.5 vs 3.8 months, HR 0.62); or Imlunestrant + Abemaciclib (median PFS 11.1 vs 5.5 months, HR 0.53).
Vepdegestrant (PROTAC ER Degrader): 200 mg PO daily (VERITAC-2 trial: median PFS 5.0 vs 2.1 months, HR 0.58).

nodes.name: PARP Inhibitor Plan
nodes.title: Germline BRCA1/2 Mutation: PARP Inhibitor Monotherapy
nodes.description: Category 1 targeted synthetic lethality for germline BRCA1/2 pathogenic variants.
bullets: Olaparib: 300 mg PO twice daily continuous (Category 1, OlympiAD trial: median PFS 7.0 vs 4.2 months vs chemotherapy, HR 0.58).
Talazoparib: 1 mg PO once daily continuous (Category 1, EMBRACA trial: median PFS 8.6 vs 5.6 months vs chemotherapy, HR 0.54).
Monitor complete blood counts monthly for anemia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia.

nodes.name: T-DXd HER2-Low Plan
nodes.title: HER2-Low / Ultralow: Fam-Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (T-DXd)
nodes.description: Category 1 antibody-drug conjugate for HER2-low and HER2-ultralow metastatic breast cancer.
bullets: Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd): 5.4 mg/kg IV q21d (Category 1 preferred, DESTINY-Breast04 trial: median PFS 10.1 vs 5.4 months, OS 23.9 vs 17.6 months, HR 0.69).
DESTINY-Breast06 Trial: Extends T-DXd benefit to chemo-naive endocrine-refractory patients with HER2-low (PFS 13.2 vs 8.1 mo, HR 0.62) AND HER2-ultralow (IHC 0+, PFS 13.2 vs 8.3 mo, HR 0.78).
Toxicity Warning: Monitor for Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD) / pneumonitis (occurs in 11-12%). Interrupt immediately for Grade 1 (asymptomatic ground glass); permanently discontinue for Grade >=2.

nodes.name: Wild-Type 2L Plan
nodes.title: Biomarker-Negative 2L: Everolimus + Exemestane or Fulvestrant
nodes.description: mTOR inhibition overcoming endocrine resistance in biomarker-negative disease.
bullets: Everolimus + Exemestane: Everolimus 10 mg PO daily + Exemestane 25 mg PO daily (Category 1, BOLERO-2 trial: median PFS 11.0 vs 4.1 months, HR 0.38). Use steroid mouthwash to prevent stomatitis.
Fulvestrant Monotherapy: 500 mg IM Days 1, 15, then monthly (CONFIRM trial).
CDK4/6 Switch: Abemaciclib + Fulvestrant if palbociclib was used in 1L (postMONARCH trial: PFS HR 0.73).

nodes.name: HR+ Refractory Plan
nodes.title: Endocrine-Refractory HR+/HER2-: Antibody-Drug Conjugates and Chemotherapy
nodes.description: Sequential ADCs and cytotoxic chemotherapy for endocrine-refractory disease.
bullets: Sacituzumab govitecan: 10 mg/kg IV Days 1, 8 q21d (Category 1 preferred, TROPiCS-02 trial: median OS 14.4 vs 11.2 months, HR 0.79).
Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd): 6 mg/kg IV q21d (Category 2A, TROPION-Breast01 trial: median PFS 7.2 vs 3.6 months, HR 0.63).
Sequential Single-Agent Chemotherapy: Capecitabine (1000-1250 mg/m2 PO BID d1-14 q21d), weekly Paclitaxel, liposomal Doxorubicin, or Eribulin.

nodes.name: HER2+ Metastatic Plan
nodes.title: Metastatic HER2-Positive: Evidence-Based Line Sequencing
nodes.description: Definitive sequential therapy algorithm for metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer.
bullets: First-Line (1L): Docetaxel + Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab (THP) (Category 1 preferred, CLEOPATRA trial: median OS 57.1 vs 40.8 months, HR 0.66). Maintenance Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab +/- Endocrine therapy (PATINA trial).

Second-Line (2L): Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) 5.4 mg/kg IV q21d (Category 1 preferred, DESTINY-Breast03 trial: median PFS 29 vs 7.2 months vs T-DM1, HR 0.30; 70% reduction in progression/death).

Third-Line (3L): Tucatinib 300 mg PO BID + Capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 PO BID d1-14 + Trastuzumab (Category 1 preferred, HER2CLIMB trial: active brain metastases OS 18.1 vs 12.0 months, HR 0.58) OR T-DM1 (EMILIA trial).
Fourth-Line and Beyond: Margetuximab-cmkb + Chemotherapy (SOPHIA trial), Lapatinib + Capecitabine/Trastuzumab, or Neratinib + Capecitabine (NALA trial).

nodes.name: Metastatic TNBC Plan
nodes.title: Metastatic Triple-Negative: Biomarker-Directed Therapy
nodes.description: Category 1 line sequencing for advanced triple-negative breast cancer.
bullets: 1L with PD-L1 CPS >= 10: Pembrolizumab 200 mg q21d + Chemotherapy (nab-Paclitaxel, Paclitaxel, or Gemcitabine/Carboplatin) (Category 1 preferred, KEYNOTE-355 trial: median OS 23.0 vs 16.1 months, HR 0.73) OR Sacituzumab govitecan + Pembrolizumab (ASCENT-04).

1L with PD-L1 CPS < 10: Sacituzumab govitecan 10 mg/kg IV Days 1, 8 q21d (Category 1 preferred, ASCENT-03 trial: median PFS 9.7 vs 6.9 months, HR 0.62) OR Datopotamab deruxtecan (TROPION-Breast02) OR Platinum chemotherapy (Carboplatin/Cisplatin).
Germline BRCA1/2 Pathogenic Variant: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID or Talazoparib 1 mg PO daily (Category 1, OlympiAD / EMBRACA trials).
Second-Line and Beyond: Sacituzumab govitecan (ASCENT trial: median OS 12.1 vs 6.7 months, HR 0.48); Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan if HER2-low (DESTINY-Breast04); sequential single-agent chemotherapy.

nodes.name: IBC Protocol
nodes.title: Inflammatory Breast Cancer (cT4d): Trimodality Curative Therapy
nodes.description: Curative multimodality protocol for inflammatory breast cancer.
bullets: Step 1 (Preoperative Chemotherapy): Anthracycline + Taxane regimen (Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel). Add Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab if HER2-positive (Category 1). Upfront surgery is CONTRAINDICATED.

Step 2 (Definitive Surgery): Modified Radical Mastectomy with Level I/II Axillary Lymph Node Dissection. (Breast-conserving surgery and skin-sparing/nipple-sparing mastectomy are STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED due to dermal lymphatic involvement).
Step 3 (Post-Mastectomy Radiation): PMRT to chest wall with bolus + comprehensive RNI (supraclavicular and internal mammary nodes) (Category 1).
Step 4 (Adjuvant Systemic Therapy): Complete 1 year of anti-HER2 therapy if HER2+; add endocrine therapy if HR+; delayed reconstruction only.

nodes.name: Phyllodes Protocol
nodes.title: Phyllodes Tumor: Wide Surgical Excision (≥1 cm Margins)
nodes.description: Surgical resection guidelines for benign, borderline, and malignant phyllodes tumors.
bullets: Surgical Excision: Wide local excision with tumor-free surgical margins of >=1 cm without axillary staging.
Total Mastectomy: Required ONLY if >=1 cm negative margins cannot be achieved with breast conservation.
Axillary Staging: SLNB and ALND are NOT indicated (phyllodes tumors metastasize hematogenously, rarely to lymph nodes).
Adjuvant Systemic Therapy: Chemotherapy and endocrine therapy have NO proven benefit and are not recommended.
Radiation Therapy: Consider chest wall / breast RT for large (>5 cm) malignant phyllodes tumors with narrow margins.

nodes.name: Paget Protocol
nodes.title: Paget Disease of the Nipple: Local and Underlying Cancer Management
nodes.description: Diagnostic and surgical management of Paget disease of the nipple-areolar complex.
bullets: Workup: Full-thickness skin biopsy of involved nipple-areolar complex (NAC); bilateral mammogram + ultrasound; breast MRI to detect occult parenchymal disease.
Surgical Options:
• Central lumpectomy including total resection of NAC with clear margins + Whole-Breast RT (Category 1).
• Total Mastectomy including NAC +/- SLNB +/- breast reconstruction.
Axillary Management: Perform SLNB if underlying invasive cancer is present, or if mastectomy is performed.
Systemic Therapy: Governed by the stage and ER/PR/HER2 receptor status of the underlying parenchymal malignancy.

nodes.name: Pregnancy Protocol
nodes.title: Breast Cancer Diagnosed During Pregnancy: Trimester-Safe Protocols
nodes.description: Fetal-safe multidisciplinary oncology protocols during pregnancy.
bullets: First Trimester: Modified radical mastectomy with axillary staging preferred (therapeutic RT cannot be delivered). Chemotherapy is STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in the 1st trimester (teratogenic risk).

Second and Third Trimesters: Chemotherapy CAN be safely administered (FAC or Dose-Dense AC followed by weekly Paclitaxel). Discontinue chemotherapy at week 35 or 3 weeks before planned delivery to avoid maternal/fetal myelosuppression.

STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED DURING PREGNANCY: Radiation therapy (fetal microcephaly, malformations), Endocrine therapy (Tamoxifen, AIs), HER2-targeted agents (Trastuzumab/Pertuzumab cause oligohydramnios/fetal renal failure), Antibody-Drug Conjugates, and PARP inhibitors.
Delivery & Postpartum: Coordinate with Maternal-Fetal Medicine (MFM); complete RT, anti-HER2, and endocrine therapy postpartum.
